decision: Hardcode per-model rates as operator-editable markdown table in BODY; substring-match opus/sonnet/haiku with fallback rate + unknown-model flag
alternatives: import a pricing table from packages
reasoning: No pricing table exists in packages and BODY is instruction prose not code (no runtime import); model strings drift across -4-5/-4-6/-4-7 so substring match is robust
risk: Hardcoded rates go stale vs real pricing; mitigated by operator-editable framing + verify-current-pricing caveat

decision: Attribution buckets via meta.role: executor = role==='executor'; structure = every other role (unknown/future roles default to structure)
reasoning: No agentType field exists; meta.role is the only discriminator; defaulting unknown roles to structure is conservative (won't undercount executor cost)
risk: A future genuinely-executor-class role with a different role string would be misbucketed as structure

decision: Define first-pass-success = exactly one review.iteration ending APPROVED, verify passed, no fix re-entry
alternatives: zero mustFix items on first review
reasoning: REQ-13 names cost/first-pass-success but does not define first-pass; this is the most precise definition derivable from existing review.iteration + verify telemetry
risk: Operator may expect a looser/stricter definition; metric meaning shifts if telemetry lacks a clean APPROVED-with-no-fix signal

decision: Guard all 3 asks with index.test.ts using readFileSync(BODY)+toContain in per-ask named describe blocks; no -t-only probes
alternatives: rely on source-grep ac probes only
reasoning: Body is prose so unit logic is untestable, but per-named-block toContain assertions fail loudly on any partial directive drop (G-DX-003 anti-vacuous-test guard); improves on phase-1 ac-12
risk: Token-presence tests can't verify the directive is correct, only present; semantic correctness still depends on LLM execution of the prose
